messages:
maya: Heads up — noticed some embedding requests returning varied dims when we batch mixed inputs. Root cause unknown, reproducible locally with small script.
josh: can you paste the minimal repro?
maya: repro: ```python
inputs = ["hello", "", "This is a longer sentence."]
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="open-embed-v2", input=inputs, batch_size=4)
print([len(v) for v in resp.data])
```
Getting [1536, 0, 1536] sometimes. empty string producing zero-dim vector.
liam: empty string -> we used to pad with zeroed vector in runtime, but recent kv-cache patch changed serializer maybe.
alexa: @maya did you try sending single-input request for empty string? expected 1536 not 0
maya: single-input returns 1536. Batching seems to cause a handshake/skip for zero-length inputs. Also saw errors in request logs: `payload size mismatch` but not thrown to client.
sneh: this smells like our batching aggregator dropping empty chunks during concat, then downstream deserializer assumes missing index -> default length 0. I'll take a look.
maya: this has product impact — customers doing text-diff or embeddings for doc splits that can be empty are getting inconsistent shapes. Console telemetry shows spike in "embedding_schema_mismatch" events from a few tenants.
josh: do we treat any empty segments as no-op before creating embedding? I thought we normalize to `" "`. If so fallback should be server-side.
liam: check `tokenizer.tokenize("")` — different tokenizers behave differently. But we should enforce canonicalization at API edge: convert empty->single space. That fixes many models' inconsistencies.
alexa: Agree, API edge canonicalization + a warning event in telemetry. Also need to handle for streaming batch backpressure where batcher coalesces by size and might reorder indexes.
sneh: timeline: quick patch to API-normalize empty->" "; add unit test + e2e test for batched index mapping. Then add console alert (per-route) for schema mismatches. Target: today for patch, Monday for rollout to prod.
ops-bot: deploy triggered by sneh on canary cluster (deploy/embeds-normalize-v1) at 1769010200 :rocket:
maya: thanks. Also can we add a debug flag to log raw input lengths in telemetry for 24h to validate fix?
josh: yes, add `embeddings.input_len_histogram` metric with tag `route` and `model` (low cost).
alexa: small UX note for rollouts: console should show an inline blurb on routes when a recent fix changed semantics (dims/padding) so customers can opt-in test. Filing product ticket.
maya: filing follows up: I'll post a short message thread for affected tenants and set a flag to trigger automatic re-embedding suggestion in console.
liam: PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/embeddings/pull/482 — adds normalization + tests.
sneh: merging now.
ops-bot: canary deployment success (canary=3 pods) at 1769010450 :white_check_mark:
maya: monitoring — early signals look good, schema mismatch events dropped to 0 in canary.
alexa: planning to add a docs blurb about "empty segments and embeddings" and small note in SDKs.
maya: closing loop: will run a re-embed job for impacted customer subset after we get green across regions. Thanks team :thumbsup:
